name: Sofitel Saigon Plaza
short_description: A 284-room hotel on Le Duan Boulevard in District 1, walking distance to Notre Dame Cathedral and the Independence Palace, with an 18th-floor pool and club lounge.
ai_summary: Sofitel Saigon Plaza sits in a quiet enclave on Le Duan Boulevard in downtown District 1, putting Notre Dame Cathedral, the Independence Palace, the Central Post Office, and the Zoo and Botanical Garden all within easy walking distance. The 284-room hotel's 18th-floor pool and club lounge offer sweeping city views, and its fitness centre is widely regarded as one of the best hotel gyms in Ho Chi Minh City. Guests consistently praise the elegant French-Vietnamese decor, attentive and accommodating staff (including for families with children), and the breakfast spread, though some reviews note the property carries a slightly dated feel in places and occasional noise between rooms.

faqs.question: Is Sofitel Saigon Plaza close to Notre Dame Cathedral?
faqs.answer: Yes -- it sits in a quiet enclave on Le Duan Boulevard in District 1, within easy walking distance of Notre Dame Cathedral, the Independence Palace, the Central Post Office, and the Zoo and Botanical Garden.

faqs.question: Does Sofitel Saigon Plaza have a rooftop pool?
faqs.answer: Yes -- the pool and club lounge are on the 18th floor, offering sweeping views over Ho Chi Minh City, alongside a fitness centre widely regarded as one of the best hotel gyms in the city.
